mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT MFG_TECH label,MFG_TECH value FROM A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO A
SELECT DISTINCT GROUP_TECH label,GROUP_TECH value FROM A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO A

SELECT DISTINCT REAL_MODULE label, REAL_MODULE value FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD A WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND #{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IN ('N1','N1A1') UNION SELECT DISTINCT REAL_MODULE label, REAL_MODULE value FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 A WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND #{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IN ('N1A3','N1')

SELECT EQP_G label,EQP_G value FROM( SELECT A.EQP_G, CASE WHEN B.MODULE IS NOT NULL THEN B.MODULE WHEN A.MODULE IN('FA', 'INT','Measurement') THEN 'METRO' ELSE A.MODULE END MODULE FROM( SELECT DISTINCT EQP_G,MODULE FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'AND #{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IN ('N1','N1A1') )A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT KEY1 MODULE,KEY2 EQP_G FROM A1_MFG.CRITICLE_COMMENT_SUMMARY@TO_A3MFG B WHERE FUNCTION_NAME ='EQPG MODULE' )B ON A.EQP_G = B.EQP_G UNION SELECT A.EQP_G, CASE WHEN B.MODULE IS NOT NULL THEN B.MODULE WHEN A.MODULE IN('FA', 'INT','Measurement') THEN 'METRO' ELSE A.MODULE END MODULE FROM( SELECT DISTINCT EQP_G,MODULE FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'AND #{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IN ('N1','N1A3') )A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT KEY1 MODULE,KEY2 EQP_G FROM A1_MFG.CRITICLE_COMMENT_SUMMARY@TO_A3MFG B WHERE FUNCTION_NAME ='EQPG MODULE' )B ON A.EQP_G = B.EQP_G ) WHERE 1=1
AND MODULE = #{module,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

WITH DATE_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, B.MFG_MODULE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,4) AS SHIFT_YEAR,SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,6) AS SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE FROM A3MFGYW1.CLIP_CALENDAR A WHERE A.SHIFT_MONTH >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') AND A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >= '20260101' )A JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MFG_MODULE FROM A1_MFG.PH_EQP_PORT_SUMMARY WHERE FAB_PHASE =#{fab}) B ON 1=1 ) , RAW_DATA AS ( --历史一年数据 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , SUM(SEFA_COUNT) AS SEFA_COUNT FROM A1_MFG.PH_EQP_PORT_SUMMARY A WHERE A.FAB_PHASE =#{fab} AND A.SHIFT_MONTH >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, A.FAB_PHASE, A.MFG_MODULE UNION ALL --实时 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , COUNT(1) AS SEFA_COUNT FROM A1_MFG.V_PR_EQP_PORT A WHERE A.FAB_PHASE =#{fab} GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, A.FAB_PHASE, A.MFG_MODULE ) , SUMMARY_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , B.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE >='20251224' THEN NVL(B.SEFA_COUNT,0) ELSE B.SEFA_COUNT END AS SEFA_COUNT FROM DATE_DATA A LEFT JOIN RAW_DATA B ON A.SHIFT_DATE =B.SHIFT_DATE AND A.MFG_MODULE =B.MFG_MODULE ORDER BY A.SHIFT_DATE ) , FINAL_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_MONTH AS SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , ROUND(AVG(SEFA_COUNT),0) AS SEFA_COUNT , 1 AS SEQ_NO FROM SUMMARY_DATA A GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.MFG_MODULE UNION ALL SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.SEFA_COUNT , 2 AS SEQ_NO FROM SUMMARY_DATA A WHERE A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR (SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >=TO_CHAR (SYSDATE-7.5/24-29,'YYYYMMDD') ) SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.SEFA_COUNT , CASE WHEN SHIFT_DATE = A.SHIFT_MONTH THEN A.SEFA_COUNT END AS MONTH_SEFA_COUNT , CASE WHEN SHIFT_DATE <> A.SHIFT_MONTH THEN A.SEFA_COUNT END AS DATE_SEFA_COUNT , A.SEQ_NO FROM FINAL_DATA A ORDER BY A.SEQ_NO, A.SHIFT_DATE, A.MFG_MODULE

WITH RAW_DATA AS ( --历史一年数据 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , SEFA_COUNT FROM A1_MFG.PH_EQP_PORT_SUMMARY A WHERE A.FAB_PHASE =#{fab} AND A.MFG_MODULE =#{module} AND A.SHIFT_MONTH >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') UNION ALL --实时 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , COUNT(1) AS SEFA_COUNT FROM A1_MFG.V_PR_EQP_PORT A WHERE A.FAB_PHASE =#{fab} AND A.MFG_MODULE =#{module} GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, A.FAB_PHASE, A.MFG_MODULE, A.EQP_G ) , DATE_DATA AS ( SELECT DISTINCT A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, B.MFG_MODULE, B.EQP_G FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,4) AS SHIFT_YEAR,SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,6) AS SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE FROM A3MFGYW1.CLIP_CALENDAR A WHERE A.SHIFT_DATE >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -11), 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >= '20260101' )A JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT A.MFG_MODULE, A.EQP_G FROM RAW_DATA A ) B ON 1=1 ) , SUMMARY_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE >='20251224' THEN NVL(B.SEFA_COUNT,0) ELSE B.SEFA_COUNT END AS SEFA_COUNT FROM DATE_DATA A LEFT JOIN RAW_DATA B ON A.SHIFT_DATE = B.SHIFT_DATE AND A.EQP_G =B.EQP_G ) , FINAL_DATA AS ( --by月 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_MONTH AS SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , CEIL(AVG(SEFA_COUNT)) AS SEFA_COUNT FROM SUMMARY_DATA A GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.EQP_G , A.MFG_MODULE UNION ALL --by天 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , SUM(A.SEFA_COUNT) AS SEFA_COUNT FROM SUMMARY_DATA A WHERE A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR (SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >=TO_CHAR (SYSDATE-7.5/24-29,'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.EQP_G , A.MFG_MODULE, A.SHIFT_DATE ) , EQP_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , A.SEFA_COUNT , 1 AS SEQ_NO FROM FINAL_DATA A UNION ALL SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , 'TOTAL' AS EQP_G , SUM(A.SEFA_COUNT) AS SEFA_COUNT , 2 AS SEQ_NO FROM FINAL_DATA A GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.MFG_MODULE, A.SHIFT_DATE ) SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE ,CASE WHEN A.EQP_G = 'TOTAL' THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE A.EQP_G END AS EQP_G , A.EQP_G , A.SEFA_COUNT , A.SEQ_NO FROM EQP_DATA A ORDER BY LENGTH(SHIFT_DATE), A.SHIFT_DATE, A.SEQ_NO

WITH DATE_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, B.MFG_MODULE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,4) AS SHIFT_YEAR,SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,6) AS SHIFT_MONTH, SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,6) AS SHIFT_DATE FROM A3MFGYW1.CLIP_CALENDAR A WHERE A.SHIFT_MONTH >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -10), 'YYYYMM') AND A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >= '20260101' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,4) AS SHIFT_YEAR,SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,6) AS SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE FROM A3MFGYW1.CLIP_CALENDAR A WHERE A.SHIFT_DATE >=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >= '20260101' )A JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MFG_MODULE FROM A1_MFG.PH_MOVE_HISTORY_SUMMARY WHERE FAB_PHASE =#{fab}) B ON 1=1 ) , RAW_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , SUM(TTL_MOVE) AS TTL_MOVE , SUM(DYB_MOVE) AS DYB_MOVE , SUM(DYB_MOVE)/SUM(TTL_MOVE) AS DYB_RATIO FROM A1_MFG.PH_MOVE_HISTORY_SUMMARY A WHERE A.FAB_PHASE =#{fab} AND A.SHIFT_MONTH >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, A.FAB_PHASE, A.MFG_MODULE ) , SUMMARY_DATA AS ( --by月 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH AS SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , ROUND(SUM(DYB_MOVE)/SUM(TTL_MOVE)*100,2) AS DYB_RATIO FROM RAW_DATA A GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.FAB_PHASE, A.MFG_MODULE UNION ALL --by天 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , ROUND(A.DYB_RATIO*100,2) AS DYB_RATIO FROM RAW_DATA A WHERE A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') ) SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , B.DYB_RATIO , CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = A.SHIFT_MONTH THEN DYB_RATIO END AS MONTH_DYB_RATIO , CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE <>A.SHIFT_MONTH THEN DYB_RATIO END AS DATE_DYB_RATIO FROM DATE_DATA A LEFT JOIN SUMMARY_DATA B ON A.SHIFT_DATE = B.SHIFT_DATE AND A.MFG_MODULE= B.MFG_MODULE ORDER BY LENGTH(SHIFT_DATE), A.SHIFT_DATE

WITH DATE_DATA AS ( SELECT DISTINCT A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, B.MFG_MODULE, B.EQP_G FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,4) AS SHIFT_YEAR,SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,6) AS SHIFT_MONTH, SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,6) AS SHIFT_DATE FROM A3MFGYW1.CLIP_CALENDAR A WHERE A.SHIFT_MONTH >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -10), 'YYYYMM') AND A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >= '20260101' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,4) AS SHIFT_YEAR,SUBSTR(A.SHIFT_DATE,0,6) AS SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE FROM A3MFGYW1.CLIP_CALENDAR A WHERE A.SHIFT_DATE >=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE <=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >= '20260101' )A JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT A.MFG_MODULE, A.EQP_G FROM A1_MFG.PH_MOVE_HISTORY_SUMMARY A WHERE A.SHIFT_MONTH >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') AND A.FAB_PHASE =#{fab} AND A.MFG_MODULE =#{module} UNION ALL SELECT #{module} AS MFG_MODULE, 'TOTAL' AS EQP_G FROM DUAL ) B ON 1=1 ) , RAW_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , SUM(A.TTL_MOVE) AS TTL_MOVE , SUM(A.DYB_MOVE) AS DYB_MOVE , SUM(A.DYB_MOVE)/SUM(A.TTL_MOVE) AS DYB_RATIO FROM A1_MFG.PH_MOVE_HISTORY_SUMMARY A WHERE A.SHIFT_MONTH >=TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24, 'MM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') AND A.FAB_PHASE =#{fab} AND A.MFG_MODULE =#{module} GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.SHIFT_DATE, A.FAB_PHASE, A.MFG_MODULE, A.EQP_G ) , SUMMARY_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH AS SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , SUM(A.TTL_MOVE) AS TTL_MOVE , SUM(A.DYB_MOVE) AS DYB_MOVE , ROUND(SUM(A.DYB_MOVE)/SUM(A.TTL_MOVE)*100,2) AS DYB_RATIO FROM RAW_DATA A GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_MONTH, A.FAB_PHASE, A.MFG_MODULE, A.EQP_G UNION ALL SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , A.TTL_MOVE , A.DYB_MOVE , ROUND(A.DYB_RATIO*100,2) AS DYB_RATIO FROM RAW_DATA A WHERE A.SHIFT_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SHIFT_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') ) , FINAL_DATA AS ( SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , A.TTL_MOVE , A.DYB_MOVE , A.DYB_RATIO FROM SUMMARY_DATA A UNION ALL -- 汇总数据 SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.FAB_PHASE , A.MFG_MODULE , 'TOTAL' AS EQP_G , SUM(A.TTL_MOVE) AS TTL_MOVE , SUM(A.DYB_MOVE) AS DYB_MOVE , ROUND(SUM(A.DYB_MOVE)/SUM(A.TTL_MOVE)*100,2) AS DYB_RATIO FROM SUMMARY_DATA A GROUP BY A.SHIFT_YEAR, A.SHIFT_DATE, A.FAB_PHASE, A.MFG_MODULE ) SELECT A.SHIFT_YEAR , A.SHIFT_MONTH , A.SHIFT_DATE , A.MFG_MODULE , A.EQP_G , B.TTL_MOVE , B.DYB_MOVE , B.DYB_RATIO FROM DATE_DATA A LEFT JOIN FINAL_DATA B ON A.SHIFT_DATE = B.SHIFT_DATE AND A.EQP_G =B.EQP_G ORDER BY LENGTH(SHIFT_DATE), A.SHIFT_DATE, CASE WHEN A.EQP_G ='TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END

SELECT LOACTION,SHIFT_DATE,DEPT_ID,DEPT_QTY FROM( SELECT LOACTION, SHIFT_DATE, DEPT_ID, DEPT_QTY FROM A3MFGYW1.QS_BY_MODULE T WHERE T.SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') UNION ALL SELECT T.LOACTION,T.SHIFT_DATE,'INLINE' AS DEPT_ID,MAX(T.IN_LINE_QTY) DEPT_ID FROM A3MFGYW1.QS_BY_MODULE T WHERE T.SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY T.LOACTION,T.SHIFT_DATE )WHERE LOACTION =#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY SHIFT_DATE

SELECT EQP_G,DEPT_ID,ROUND(SUM(MANUAL_TIME),1) MANUAL_TIME,SUM(RATIO) RATIO FROM ( SELECT EQP_G,DEPT_ID DEPT_ID_ORG,RATIO,MANUAL_TIME, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY EQP_G ORDER BY RATIO DESC)>=4 THEN 'OTHER' ELSE DEPT_ID END DEPT_ID FROM ( SELECT A1.EQP_G,A1.DEPT_ID,A2.STD_RUN_TIME,A1.MANUAL_TIME, CASE WHEN A2.STD_RUN_TIME>0 THEN ROUND(100*A1.MANUAL_TIME/A2.STD_RUN_TIME,2) END RATIO FROM ( --根据下拉框选泽FORCE_TIME、DM_MEA_TIME、DYB_TIME SELECT EQP_G,DEPT_ID
,SUM(FORCE_TIME)/7
,SUM(DM_MEA_TIME)/7
,SUM(DYB_TIME)/7
MANUAL_TIME FROM A3MFGYW1.MEASUREMENT_EQP_G_FORCE WHERE DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-14,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND FAB=#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY EQP_G,DEPT_ID )A1, ( SELECT EQP_G,SUM(STD_RUN_TIME)/7 STD_RUN_TIME FROM ( SELECT FAB,EQP_G,SHIFT_DATE,MAX(STD_RUN_TIME) STD_RUN_TIME FROM A3MFGYW1.MEASUREMENT_EQP_G_FORCE WHERE 1=1
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-14,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND FAB=#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY FAB,EQP_G,SHIFT_DATE ) GROUP BY EQP_G )A2 WHERE A1.EQP_G=A2.EQP_G(+) UNION ALL SELECT X1.EQP_G,'INLINE' DEPT_ID,X1.STD_RUN_TIME,X1.STD_RUN_TIME-X2.MANUAL_TIME INLINE_TIME, CASE WHEN X1.STD_RUN_TIME>0 THEN ROUND(100*(X1.STD_RUN_TIME-X2.MANUAL_TIME)/X1.STD_RUN_TIME,2) END RATIO FROM ( SELECT EQP_G,SUM(STD_RUN_TIME)/7 STD_RUN_TIME FROM ( SELECT FAB,EQP_G,SHIFT_DATE,MAX(STD_RUN_TIME) STD_RUN_TIME FROM A3MFGYW1.MEASUREMENT_EQP_G_FORCE WHERE 1=1
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-14,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND FAB=#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY FAB,EQP_G,SHIFT_DATE ) GROUP BY EQP_G )X1, ( SELECT EQP_G,SUM(FORCE_TIME+DM_MEA_TIME+DYB_TIME)/7 MANUAL_TIME FROM A3MFGYW1.MEASUREMENT_EQP_G_FORCE WHERE DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-14,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND FAB=#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY EQP_G )X2 WHERE X1.EQP_G=X2.EQP_G ) ) GROUP BY EQP_G,DEPT_ID

SELECT EQP_G,DEPT_ID,ROUND(SUM(MANUAL_COUNT),1) MANUAL_COUNT,SUM(RATIO) RATIO FROM ( SELECT EQP_G,DEPT_ID DEPT_ID_ORG,RATIO,MANUAL_COUNT, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY EQP_G ORDER BY RATIO DESC)>=4 THEN 'OTHER' ELSE DEPT_ID END DEPT_ID FROM ( SELECT A1.EQP_G,A1.DEPT_ID,A2.TOTAL_COUNT,A1.MANUAL_COUNT, CASE WHEN A2.TOTAL_COUNT>0 THEN ROUND(100*A1.MANUAL_COUNT/A2.TOTAL_COUNT,2) END RATIO FROM ( --根据下拉框选泽FORCE_COUNT、DM_MEA_COUNT、DYB_COUNT SELECT EQP_G,DEPT_ID
,SUM(FORCE_COUNT)/7
,SUM(DM_MEA_COUNT)/7
,SUM(DYB_COUNT)/7 MANUAL_COUNT FROM A3MFGYW1.MEASUREMENT_EQP_G_FORCE WHERE DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-14,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND FAB=#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY EQP_G,DEPT_ID )A1, ( SELECT EQP_G,SUM(TOTAL_COUNT)/7 TOTAL_COUNT FROM A3MFGYW1.MEASUREMENT_EQP_G_FORCE WHERE 1=1
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-14,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND FAB=#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY EQP_G )A2 WHERE A1.EQP_G=A2.EQP_G(+) UNION ALL SELECT X1.EQP_G,'INLINE' DEPT_ID,X1.TOTAL_COUNT,X1.TOTAL_COUNT-X2.MANUAL_COUNT INLINE_COUNT, CASE WHEN X1.TOTAL_COUNT>0 THEN ROUND(100*(X1.TOTAL_COUNT-X2.MANUAL_COUNT)/X1.TOTAL_COUNT,2) END RATIO FROM ( SELECT EQP_G,SUM(TOTAL_COUNT)/7 TOTAL_COUNT FROM A3MFGYW1.MEASUREMENT_EQP_G_FORCE WHERE 1=1
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-14,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND FAB=#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY EQP_G )X1, ( SELECT EQP_G,SUM(FORCE_COUNT+DM_MEA_COUNT+DYB_COUNT)/7 MANUAL_COUNT FROM A3MFGYW1.MEASUREMENT_EQP_G_FORCE WHERE DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-14,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
